en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's read a book on the mafia
I want to scream really loud!

...
Did I do something to offend you?

To suggest something like that to me...
You've got a reason, right?

I don't have any words to leave 
behind for this world...

But, I'm curious to see what 
sort of thing you'd write.

Hmph...seems like I took an interest 
in you without even realizing it.

When it's done, bring it to me in prison.
I'm looking forward to reading it.

Are you the kind of person who 
can't handle silence?

You'd better stay out 
of prison, then.

Nights in prison get pretty bad. 
Like the stillness of death...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Ryoma looks deep in thought...
